gloss: just when, on the verge of

definitions.gloss: just when, right when, at the very moment
definitions.explanation: A point in time just as something was about to happen or had just started. Typically followed by an unexpected or inconvenient event.

examples.japanese: ⟦{出|で}かけよう→出かける：00833_dekakeru⟧とした{矢先|やさき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{降|ふ}り{出|だ}した→降り出す：03004_furidasu⟧。
examples.english: Just as I was about to leave, it started raining.

examples.japanese: ⟦{回復|かいふく}→回復：03812_kaifuku⟧し⟦かけた→かける：00854_kakeru⟧{矢先|やさき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦また→また：00969_mata⟧⟦{熱|ねつ}→熱：01690_netsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}た→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: Just when I was starting to recover, I got a fever again.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{慣|な}れて→慣れる：00870_nareru⟧きた{矢先|やさき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{転勤|てんきん}→転勤：04555_tenkin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{命|めい}じられて→命じる：02309_meijiru⟧⟦{途方|とほう}に{暮|く}れた→途方に暮れる：17548_tohounikureru⟧。
examples.english: Just when I was getting used to my new job, I was ordered to transfer and felt completely lost.

notes:
USAGE:
Used in the pattern ～⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧{矢先|やさき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ or ～⟦しよう→する：00392_suru⟧とした{矢先|やさき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧. The event that follows is almost always unexpected, inconvenient, or unfortunate. This creates a sense of bad timing or irony.

ETYMOLOGY:
{矢先|やさき} literally means "arrowhead" (⟦{矢|や}→矢：10461_ya⟧ = arrow, ⟦{先|さき}→先：02883_saki⟧ = tip). The metaphor suggests the precise point where the arrow is aimed — hence, the exact moment.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ～⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧{矢先|やさき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: just when ~ happened
- ～⟦しよう→する：00392_suru⟧とした{矢先|やさき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: just as ~ was about to ~
- ～(⟦よ→よ：09475_yo⟧)う⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦いた→いる：00495_iru⟧{矢先|やさき}: just as ~ was trying to ~
